clips.subtitleText: Level 1: Soldier boyfriend surprises his waitress girlfriend at work and she drops everything 🥺✈️
Level 2: Sprinted across the airport walkway after 2 years apart and never let go 😭❤️
Level 3: Deployed military dad secretly returns for graduation and daughter breaks down 🎓🥹
Level 4: Reunited after 1 year and 10,000 miles apart and spun her straight off her feet 🌍✨
Level 5: Dropped all her luggage and leaped into his arms as he collapsed with joy 😭💖
